title: Owner: explain a technical decision's strategic consequences, not its specifics (2026-11-05)

sections.name: owner-words
sections.label: Owner's words (verbatim)
sections.content:
ok. I can now do a bit better with the decision. 
It was explained more. 

We may however have some other kind of requirement here. 

This links back to decisions in context. 
When we have a detailed technical decision that has consequences, we need to be better at explaining the consequences, rather than the specifics. 

Since very little of my work is now writing real code, or looking at the json of the spec, the information that matters in a larger context is stategic. Each option opens up or shuts down strategic paths that are not immediately recognisable.
